name: ContainerDemurrageTracker
tagline: See every container's last free day, what demurrage and detention are charging right now and what to do next – in one Power Apps component.
description: A complete demurrage & detention desk for importers, forwarders, customs brokers and 3PLs: free-time clocks per container (last free day and last return day), tiered daily demurrage and detention rates with per-line free time and a reefer surcharge, pickup and return appointments with projected charges, holds that block gate-out, free-time extensions, line invoices compared with the calculation, disputes with a window and outcomes, who-pays decisions with an absorb limit, an Act today list, a free-time board, a 14-day calendar and costs by shipping line. Works in canvas apps, model-driven apps and Power Pages.
features: Demurrage and detention clocks with last free / return day
Tiered daily rates, per-line free time, reefer surcharge
Projected charges for pickup / return appointments
Holds that block gate-out with LFD-at-risk warnings
Line invoice vs calculation and disputes with window and outcome
Who pays: rebill, absorb within a limit, trucker, waiver
Act today list, ActionListJson and SummaryJson for flows
Bulk book pickup, plan return, release holds, who pays, assign, close + undo
Keyboard and phone layout with bottom bar
Demo mode with fictional sample data
